title: Space Illusion
paragraphs: Now then, the carriages pulled by the filolials and the rival continued moving forward. After a while, big sister’s friend stared at a certain point and raised her hand.
“Stop.”
The filolials and the rival immediately came to a halt. Big sister’s friend, still in her weasel form, hopped off the carriage and pointed a little ahead.
“There’s a boundary here.”
She chanted a small spell and stretched her hand forward, causing a ripple to appear.
“Whoa… what’s this?”
“It’s a type of barrier magic. It’s so intricately woven that the density is higher than that of the filolial sanctuary.”
“You’ve been there before?”
“It’s in the memories of the dragon emperor. But this is denser. You’d need an exceptional affinity for detecting illusions to even notice it. It feels like a multi-layered barrier.”
“But even if you can sense it, isn’t it still a problem if we can’t get through?”
“Leave it to me. As long as I know where it is, I can widen the cracks.”
This time, the rival pointed both hands in the direction big sister’s friend had indicated and focused his mind. Then, he began chanting a spell. This is a phrase I’ve heard before.
“Dragon Sanctuary!”
With a loud burst, the rival cast a spell to assert his territory. Immediately, the spot that big sister’s friend had pointed to began to crackle and spark.
“Guhhh…”
As the rival poured his power into the spell, the ripples before us trembled as if resisting.
“This is an incredibly dense magical structure. To break it, you need to strike precisely at its weak points.”
“Uh…”

At that moment, big sister raised her hand and began tracing something with her fingers. The rival watched and adjusted his movements to match hers. As they did, the sparking location started shifting.
“…Amazing. You’re precisely targeting the gaps in the fluctuating space and expanding them.”
“Raphtalia, you’re incredible!”
Big sister’s friend exclaimed. Oh, now it’s big sister’s turn. Her friend is better at detecting mirages and illusions, but big sister can sense the distortions in space. This is promising.
“After Rifana pointed it out, I started seeing it. I thought… maybe that’s the weak point?”
Eventually, the sparks settled in one place.
“Got you! Hehehe, you can’t escape anymore! I’m going to pry it open right away! Take that!”
The rival licked his lips with a sly grin… Am I the only one who thinks he’s saying that to Father? I glanced over at Father and the others, but no one seemed to notice.
What exactly is he planning to shove in after prying it open?
“Motoyasu?”
“What’s wrong, Yuki-chan?”
“Motoyasu, you’re looking at Naofumi with eyes that seem to be thinking about something completely different from everyone else.”
“Really?”
“No, that’s not it. I was just thinking that the rival was saying something obscene while teasing Father.”
“What!? That’s a great idea! I’ll add that to the list of lines to use to pin down Naofumi.”
What!? Was my guess actually correct!?
“What are you thinking about at a time like this, Motoyasu-kun!”
“Thanks to Motoyasu, that’s all I can hear now…”
“How are you going to make up for this?”
Ren and Itsuki scolded me.
Is this my fault? No, it’s not! It’s definitely the rival’s fault! While all this was happening, a crack appeared in the barrier.
“Alright! We can go through now! Let’s go!”
“There he goes with the inappropriate lines again…”
“Huh? What do you mean by that!?”
“That’s not what I meant!”
Eventually, a loud crack echoed as a fissure spread across the space before us.
“Barrier Breaker!”

With Kuro-chan’s shout, the barrier magic shattered, revealing a landscape different from before… a desert that wasn’t the same as the one we had been in moments ago. Now, I could see something spiky and ominous. There were countless pits that looked like antlion traps.
“Whoa…”
“Does this mean the path is open now?”
“I think so!”
“Alright! We’re making progress! Let’s move forward!”
“Looks like Gaelion is one step ahead.”
“Grr! This time, we’ll do it!”
“Hmm. Can you?”
Provoked by the rival, Sakura and the others puffed up their cheeks in frustration and let out a loud squeal.
Exactly. Don’t get cocky just because things went well once.
“We’ll show you!”
“Still… I feel like the atmosphere is changing little by little…”
As we continued forward with that thought, the sun began to rise. Since Father had decided we should return before the temperature rose too high, we tried to head back using the portal, but…
“Huh? The portal is unusable.”
“Maybe we’ve entered an active zone?”
“Ah, I see. Then let’s go back outside the range for now.”
“About that… I have something to report.”
“W-What?”
Father and the others, myself included, turned to look at the rival.
“Um… the barrier magic we destroyed is regenerating.”
The rival scratched his cheek, looking very troubled as he spoke.
Regenerating barrier magic?
“What do you mean by that?”
“Exactly what I said. To put it bluntly, we’re trapped.”
“Wait… what?”
“Raphatalia and Rifana searched around, but they couldn’t find any distortions to get us out.”
“Yeah. It might be one of those places where getting in is easy, but getting out is hard…”
“We’ve been looking for any seams, but even if we find something that looks promising, it doesn’t seem like we can open it.”
The big sister and her friend spoke apologetically.
This… is turning into a rather difficult situation.
“Huh? So, we’re trapped in this desert?”
“Can’t Gaelion just fly us out?”
“You don’t understand how terrifying barriers can be. There’s no helping it. Bow hero, go with Gaelion to a high altitude and see for yourself. That should make it clear.”
“Uh? Well… alright.”
Itsuki mounted the rival’s back, and they took off into the sky. After a while… the rival slowly descended back down.
“What was that? No matter how high we flew, the altitude didn’t increase at all.”
“See? We’re trapped. Whether we move forward or go back, we have to keep moving through this desert.”

“So, that means… we have to stay here during the scorching heat of the day… We’ve got enough food and water loaded in the wagon, so we should be fine, but… we should set up a camp now to stay out of the sun.”
“Understood.”

And so, we began setting up tents to escape the direct sunlight during the day. Well, with the wagons around, we could manage somehow. As the sun rose completely, a suffocating heat overwhelmed us. Even in the shade, the sweat wouldn’t stop.
“It’s so hot… too hot… what is this place…”
Ren grumbled while chanting ice magic to cool down the surroundings. He created chunks of ice to cool off. However, even that ice melted visibly fast. Honestly, the heat was unbearable.
“I never thought I’d envy Ren so much…”
“Why don’t you use ice-based skills?”
“Good point. Moments like this make you appreciate both the conveniences and inconveniences of another world.”

Everyone seemed to be finding their own way to cool off. The big sister and her friend were using water created by her big sister’s magic to cool down. But since maintaining magic-created water and ice is difficult, it would only be a temporary solution. After all, this was a desert. With no humidity, it was hard to gather moisture from the surroundings, which meant producing water consumed a lot of magic.
“Wind magic… so cool…”
The filolials were using wind magic to create breezes, cooling us down. As expected of the filolials.
“Ugh, Kuro can’t take it anymore… I’m going to die from the scorching inferno…”
Kuro-chan, unable to endure any longer, was lying limp inside the tent.
Perhaps the heat was hitting him harder because of his color?
“Black absorbs heat, you know… Kuro-chan and Ren probably feel the heat the most because of their colors.”
“Damn… I didn’t expect something like this to become a problem…”
“I’m jealous of Yuki… Kuro, why am I black…? Is it because I’m of the night… a vampire’s kin?”
“That’s just your natural color… but I feel for you. You’re not a vampire, though.”
